name: Cyan Robotics
summary:
Cyan Robotics (Qingxin Yichuang) develops embodied character robots that combine physical movement with expressive, personality-driven interaction. Its products include Amoo, a compact companion robot with a soft exterior, and a larger humanoid platform. The company also develops DinoOS, a foundation for building and reusing robot character capabilities.

Its engineering combines navigation, vision, sound localization, tactile sensing and coordinated behavior. The software architecture separates reusable capabilities from particular robot characters, allowing developers to adapt interactions for settings such as the home, education, entertainment and hospitality. Public examples include Amoo-themed commercial collaborations, illustrating the company's focus on both physical robots and character-based experiences.
